details:
* Non-maintainer upload by the TuxCare ELS team.
   * CVE-2026-45793: Stop rejecting GitHub OAuth tokens that contain "-"
     (such as GitHub Actions ghs_ installation tokens), which disclosed the
     token in the error message, and mask such tokens in debug command
     output.
     - debian/patches/0022-CVE-2026-45793.patch
   * CVE-2026-59947: Mask tokens passed in the username part of a URL
     (https://TOKEN@host/) in -vvv debug command output.
     - debian/patches/0023-CVE-2026-59947.patch
